author: scikit-plots
description: Study the topic in three increasingly detailed passes: orientation, structure, then evidence-level understanding.
empty_message: No one has generated a three-pass review for this topic yet.
instruction:
Review this topic using a three-pass approach.

Pass 1 — Orientation: explain the purpose, scope, major concepts, and why the topic matters in a few concise bullets.
Pass 2 — Structure: map the main claims, methods, relationships, disagreements, and source types; identify which parts deserve closer reading.
Pass 3 — Evidence: inspect the important claims in depth, connect them to supporting sources, note assumptions and limitations, and list the questions that remain unresolved.

Keep the three passes clearly separated and avoid pretending that unavailable source detail has been reviewed.
title: Three-Pass Review
